Flow.description: This flow is created to update Department field upon checking and matching text of Email Subject or Body on case created from Email.

formulas.name: DepartmentValue
formulas.expression:
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"high mast"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"high mast") ), "High Mast & Polygonal",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"steel pipes"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"steel pipes") ), "Steel Pipes",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"crash barrier"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"crash barrier") ), "Crash Barrier",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"steel tubular poles"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"steel tubular poles") ), "Steel Tubular Poles",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"polymer"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"polymer") ), "Polymer",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"hdpe"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"hdpe") ), "HDPE",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"transmission"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"transmission"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"telecom tower"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"telecom tower") ), "Transmission & Telecom Tower",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"pre engineering building"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"pre engineering building") ), "Pre Engineering Building",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"solar structure"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"solar structure") ), "Solar Structure",
IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Subject),"railway electrification"), CONTAINS(LOWER($Record.Description),"railway electrification") ), "Railway Electrification Structure",
"Enquiry" ))))))))))
